name: Brahmi Script
notes: The Aramaic-derivation hypothesis (Weber 1856) has been the traditionally dominant candidate, tied to Achaemenid administrative use of Aramaic in the Indus Valley, but no scholar has produced an adequate letter-by-letter derivation and significant structural mismatches remain unexplained. A rival indigenous/Indus-script-derivation hypothesis is characterized in the literature as speculative given the ~1000-year material gap. origin_type coded UNCERTAIN, not ADAPTATION, reflecting this unresolved state.
